result.title: QVR3D: Query-Guided Visual Reasoning for Training-Free 3D Grounding
result.summary: 3D visual grounding localizes objects in 3D scenes from natural language descriptions, requiring reasoning over semantics, spatial relationships, and multi-view observations. Training-free approaches avoid costly annotations but often rely on explicit scene transformation or scene-level frame selection, which may waste limited visual capacity on query-irrelevant regions. We observe that effective grounding should prioritize observations that provide evidence for the query rather than uniformly represent the entire scene. Based on this insight, we introduce QVR3D, a query-guided visual reasoning framework that operates on RGB-D observations using off-the-shelf foundation models. QVR3D combines Query-Guided Maximum Coverage (QGMC) for selecting complementary query-relevant views with Grounding Probability Estimation (GPE) that integrates instance confidence, attribute consistency, and relationship consistency. The framework supports both single- and multi-object grounding without task-specific adaptation. Experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, while QGMC also improves frame efficiency across multiple 3D vision-language tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/jwliao1209/QVR3D.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练的 3D 视觉定位框架 QVR3D，用 Query-Guided Maximum Coverage 从 RGB-D 观测中选出与查询相关且互补的视角，再用结合实例置信度、属性一致性与关系一致性的 Grounding Probability Estimation 打分，在 ScanRefer、Nr3D 上取得零样本 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「优先选取能为查询提供证据的观测而非均匀表示整个场景」的思路与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、有限视觉容量分配问题相通，最大覆盖式子集选择或可供核查能否用于 latent 工作区的帧或 token 选择，但该工作只操作显式 3D 观测，不涉及内部推理状态。
